title: Curvature: the Riemann tensor, Bianchi identity and geodesic deviation
summary: Weak-field geodesics and Newton's law; the Riemann tensor from transport round a loop and from commuting covariant derivatives; symmetries and the twenty components; Ricci tensor and scalar; geodesic deviation as tides; the Bianchi identity.

objectives.description: Objectives will be finalised when the unit is prepared; the source material is 8.962 Lectures 10–11 (Lecture Guide pages 2–3), Tong Chapter 3 and Carroll Chapter 3.

preparation.description: Read the Lecture Guide's synopsis of Lecture 10 (PDF page 2): weak-field geodesics and the Riemann tensor from transport round a parallelogram.
Read the Lecture Guide's synopses of the end of Lecture 10 (Riemann symmetries, twenty components, commutator form) and Lecture 11 (Ricci, geodesic deviation, Bianchi identity) (PDF page 3).
Watch Lectures 10 and 11 from the video gallery (transcripts on each lecture page).
Second account: Tong, General Relativity, Chapter 3 Introducing Riemannian Geometry (reference-only).
Optional: Carroll, Chapter 3 Curvature (Riemann tensor, geodesic deviation), reference-only.
